subject: C6i results (c6hc)
body: (1) site=1196 root cause: kernel nord2_gpu_allocation_size caps a context at 64 MiB INCLUDING imported IOSurfaces and returns kIOReturnBadArgument (=0xE00002C2, same value as bridge BAD) when exceeded; the 11 MB display snapshot no longer fits. Snapshot was still taken because these draws framebuffer-fetch (TEGU_GENERIC_DRAW_ATTACHMENT; luma_boost, fixed_frag fetch variants). Snapshots are freed per draw (not retained per command); budget is consumed by 3 imported displays + 1125x2436 private targets. FIX: own-pixel framebuffer fetch under LOAD reads the target in place (one draw = one fragment job, tile written back after all its fragments = same pre-draw value as the copy); snapshot kept only for CLEAR+fetch and for sampling the target as a texture (now a distinct failure site). Host repro reproduces the exact device line on HEAD (jobs=61 site=1196/0 job=3) with a modelled >8 MB alloc refusal and passes with the fix. A failed job keeps failing its command buffer (Metal error semantics; skipping a draw and reporting success would be inexact). (2) black home: new since compute delta19 made f43 targets render; their consumers sample f43 -> frontend refused (neutral image rc=-13) -> frame dropped. Frontend admits 43 now; Rust planner texture class still refuses (posted to compute; test shows C6F_PENDING). (3) compute v2 dispatch: code BO now added right after the command block; a full request refuses instead of silently dropping it. Gates: iOS -Werror x3 + bridge OK; run_host_tests all PASS (bridge test: LOAD + fetch in place, target-as-texture still snapshots) except NORD2_AIR_LLVM_BIN; integration 1005, only the unrevised CA natural-stride oracle fails; render harness PASS; CA test 36 checks ASan+release PASS, pending=1 (f43 sampling Rust).
